episode.title: Roman Concrete Can Heal Its Own Cracks

synopsis: Ancient Roman harbour concrete self-heals micro-cracks through mineral reactions with ocean water.

title_card.title: Roman concrete heals its own cracks.
title_card.subtitle: Ancient sea walls still stand after 2000 years.

caption:
Roman concrete can heal its own cracks over time.

Marine structures built along the Mediterranean coastline utilized lime clasts and volcanic ash. Scientific analysis in 2017 confirmed that seawater reacts with these materials to continuously repair micro-cracks over centuries.
